# reading data

```{r}

glb1_pilot_data <- read_xlsx(
  "C:/Users/Ewan Gerken/Desktop/R projects/MPS_IV_Alcian_staining/MO_glb1_injection_1_data.xlsx"
) %>% 
  mutate(
    fish_id = as.factor(fish_id),
    age = as.numeric(age),

                                             "control_2", 
                                             "glb1_2",
                                             "control_4",
                                             "glb1_4",
                                             "control_6",
                                             "glb1_6")),

    CH_CH_angle = as.numeric(CH_CH_angle),

age5 <-

age6 <-
```

# overall anova effect sizes

```{r}

#overall anova effect size

aov(M_CH_length ~ inj_group, data = age4) %>% 
  cohens_f()

pwr.anova.test(
  k = 7,
  f = 0.51,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  power = 0.80
)

##anova workflow function

anova_power <- function(data, response, group, age){

  # Fit one-way ANOVA
  model <- aov(
    formula = as.formula(paste(response, "~", group)),
    data = data
  )

  # Extract ANOVA statistics
  anova_summary <- summary(model)[[1]]

  f_stat <- anova_summary["F value"][1,1]
  p_value <- anova_summary["Pr(>F)"][1,1]

  # Effect sizes
  eta <- eta_squared(model)$Eta2[1]

  cohens_results <- cohens_f(model)

  observed_f <- cohens_results$Cohens_f[1]
  lower_f <- cohens_results$CI_low[1]

  # Number of groups
  k_groups <- nlevels(droplevels(data[[group]]))

  # Power calculation using observed Cohen's f
  observed_n <- tryCatch(
    {
      pwr.anova.test(
        k = k_groups,
        f = observed_f,
        sig.level = 0.05,
        power = 0.80
      )$n
    },
    error = function(e) NA
  )

  # Power calculation using lower CI Cohen's f
  lowerCI_n <- tryCatch(
    {
      if(!is.na(lower_f) && lower_f > 0){

        pwr.anova.test(
          k = k_groups,
          f = lower_f,
          sig.level = 0.05,
          power = 0.80
        )$n

      } else {
        NA
      }
    },
    error = function(e) NA
  )

  # Output clean table row
  data.frame(
    Age = age,
    Measurement = response,
    F_value = f_stat,
    p_value = p_value,
    Eta_squared = eta,
    Cohen_f = observed_f,
    Cohen_f_lower95CI = lower_f,
    n_observed_f = ceiling(observed_n),
    n_lowerCI_f = ceiling(lowerCI_n)
  )
}

#measurements

measurements <- c(
  "M_CH_length",
  "CH_CH_angle",
  "PQ_M_angle",
  "cranio_width",
  "PQ_length"
)

#results

glb1_anova_power_results <- rbind(

  # 4 dpf
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(measurements, function(x)
      anova_power(age4, x, "inj_group", "4 dpf")
    )
  ),

  # 5 dpf
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(measurements, function(x)
      anova_power(age5, x, "inj_group", "5 dpf")
    )
  ),

  # 6 dpf
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(measurements, function(x)
      anova_power(age6, x, "inj_group", "6 dpf")
    )
  )
)

#output

write.csv(

)

)
```

# pairwise power calculations (hedge's g)

```{r}

#function to subset by group comparison

calc_g <- function(data, measurement_name, control, test){

  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(inj_group %in% c(control, test))

  hedges_g(
    reformulate("inj_group", response = measurement_name),
    data = subset_data
  )

}


#testing function

calc_g(age4, "M_CH_length", "control_2", "glb1_2")
calc_g(age4, "M_CH_length", "control_4", "glb1_4")
calc_g(age4, "M_CH_length", "control_6", "glb1_6")

calc_g(age5, "M_CH_length", "control_6", "glb1_6") %>%
  .$Hedges_g %>%                 # Extract Hedges' g estimate
  abs() %>%                      # Remove directionality
  pwr.t.test(
    d = .,
    sig.level = 0.05,
    power = 0.90,
    type = "two.sample",
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )

#manual test
  pwr.t.test(
    d = -0.37503,
    sig.level = 0.05,
    power = 0.80,
    type = "two.sample",
    alternative = "less"
  )
  
  # more complete function
  
  power_curve_data <- function(data, measurement, control, test,
                             comparison,
                             n_range = 3:40){

  g <- calc_g(data, measurement, control, test) %>%
    .$Hedges_g %>%
    abs()

  data.frame(
    Comparison = comparison,
    n = n_range,
    power = sapply(
      n_range,
      function(n){

        pwr.t.test(
          n = n,
          d = g,
          sig.level = 0.05,
          type = "two.sample",
          alternative = "two.sided"
        )$power

      }
    )
  )

  }
  


```

```{r}
          legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_markdown(size=16),
          legend.text = element_text(size=20),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(y = "PQ length (mm)",
         x = "",
         title = "**5 dpf**")


pq6plot <- age6 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = inj_group, y = PQ_length)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(x = inj_group, y = PQ_length, colour = inj_group), 
                width = 0.2, size = 3) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, colour= "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                       label = "p.format",
                       p.adjust.method = "bonferroni",
                       comparisons = MO_comparisons, 
                       bracket.size = 0.5, 
                       size = 5, 
                       step.increase = 0.05,
                       tip.length = 0.025) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,0.35), 
                       breaks = seq(0,0.6,0.05)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    theme(plot.title = element_markdown(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 26),
          axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 14, margin = margin(0,6.5,0,0)),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.text = element_markdown(size = 16, margin = margin(2,0,0,0)),
          #strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_markdown(size=16),
          legend.text = element_text(size=20),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(y = "PQ length (mm)",
         x = "",
         title = "**6 dpf**")

#combined PQ length plot

ggarrange(pq4plot, pq5plot, pq6plot,
          common.legend = T, legend = "none", ncol = 1, nrow = 3)

ggsave(filename = "PQ_comb_plot_v1.png", 
       path = "output/", width = 9, height = 12, dpi = 300)

PQ_5_curve <-
  bind_rows(
    power_curve_data(
      age5,
      "PQ_length",
      "control_2",
      "glb1_2",
      "2 ng"
    ),
    power_curve_data(
      age5,
      "PQ_length",
      "control_4",
      "glb1_4",
      "4 ng"

      "PQ_length",
      "control_6",
      "glb1_6",
      "6 ng"
    ))

PQ_5_curveplot <- ggplot(
  PQ_5_curve,
  aes(x = n, y = power, colour = Comparison)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), 
                       breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +

                       breaks = seq(0,30,5)) +
  labs(

    y = "Power",
    colour = "Injection concentration"
  )
```
